name: Wells Fargo

SDE (India campus).dsaDepth: Moderate - an OA (aptitude, verbal, coding) then 1-2 technical rounds and an HR round, with DBMS and OS fundamentals weighted alongside DSA
rounds: Online assessment: aptitude, verbal reasoning, and coding questions (some pipelines add SQL, REST API and code-reading/debugging sections)

Technical round(s): DSA problems (often easy-medium, e.g. buy/sell stocks), OS fundamentals (process vs thread is a recurring question), DBMS, and project discussion - some loops split this into 2 rounds (one project-focused, one DBMS/critical-thinking-focused)
HR/behavioral round: cultural fit, communication, sometimes an emphasis on academic CGPA
extraTopics: OS fundamentals (process/thread, CPU layers) tested explicitly and repeatedly across reports
DBMS and critical-thinking questions in a dedicated round, not just folded into general technical discussion
SDE (India campus).notes: India round counts vary from 2 to 4 across reports (Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Varanasi); one report describes a multi-month gap between rounds - the timeline can be notably slow.

Senior Software Engineer.dsaDepth: Moderate - a HackerRank pre-screen, then a coding round and a managerial round; tech-stack-specific rounds (e.g. .NET/SQL for Microsoft-stack roles) appear for some teams
rounds: Technical round: 2 LeetCode-medium coding problems with an interviewer on the call, sometimes combined with OOP/high-level-design questions, multithreading and collections internals
Managerial round: past projects and managerial/behavioral questions
Some tech-stack-specific loops (e.g. Microsoft/.NET) add a technical round weighted toward OOP, .NET and SQL, then a manager round, then a director/business round
extraTopics: Multithreading and Java collections internals (hashCode/equals, collision handling) came up explicitly in one report
Application architecture discussion for more senior/stack-specific loops
